rows.title: [Bug]: Triton fused MoE incorrectly indexes per-channel weight scales with per-tensor activations
rows.version: 0.30.0 (open; fix PR #58570 open)
rows.expected_boundary: kernel:vllm.fused_moe (INT8 weight-scale layout per-channel vs per-tensor)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 with the fix PR's probe through the public fused_experts (static INT8 activations + per-channel weight scales: multiplying the routed expert's W13 channel scales by 4 leaves the output unchanged, max abs change 0.0, while the unrouted expert's perturbation is visible - the config has no per_out_ch_quant yet); entail on: the Triton launches pass (strides are passed); the scale layout the kernel is told is not a fact entail reads

rows.title: [Bug]: ExampleHiddenStatesConnector returns nan for hybrid attention model
rows.version: reported (June 2026, pre-#45849; read from the env dump at reproduction)
rows.expected_boundary: container:vllm.kv_connector (hidden-states group of a hybrid model's KV cache)
rows.note: not reproduced on the reported vLLM 0.23.0 (venv vllm0230 with transformers 5.12.1; Qwen3.5-4B, extract_hidden_states + ExampleHiddenStatesConnector, the reporter's script adapted to one card): the saved hidden states hold no NaN (205 x 2560, finite; cosine to the CPU transformers reference median 0.97, min 0.73; magnitudes differ, absmax 26.5 vs 58.75 - a layer or norm difference, not garbage). Two things entail did on this run: (1) with every adapter on, the vllm_serve adapter's get_parser wrapper raised TypeError (0.23.0's ParserManager.get_parser takes is_harmony) and the API server died - entail broke the run (principle 12; DEFERRED 21), so the entail-on result comes from a run with ENTAIL_SKIP=vllm_serve; (2) in that run entail said broken at container:vllm.allocate_slots for KV groups 0, 1 and 2 ('holds 512 KV slots for 205 tokens, not one allocation unit (256)') - not the expected boundary; real over-allocation on 0.23.0's hybrid block alignment or a rule mismatch, to be analysed after the replay (DEFERRED 22)

rows.title: [Bug]: Gemma4 parser classifies plain output without channel markers differently in streaming and no
rows.version: reported (July 2026, pre-#48262; read from the env dump at reproduction)
rows.expected_boundary: request:vllm.reasoning_parser (gemma4, streaming vs non-streaming state)
rows.note: reproduced on the reported vLLM 0.24.0 (venv vllm0240; the report's Gemma4Parser drive: non-streaming returns the plain answer as content, streaming returns every chunk as reasoning and no content); entail on: no decision (the parser's state machine is not a site; the request-settings rule covers names, not classification)

rows.title: Division by zero in rescale_noise_cfg can produce NaNs during inference
rows.expected_boundary: load:diffusers.guidance (rescale_noise_cfg with zero-variance noise_cfg)
rows.note: reproduced on diffusers 0.40.0 (rescale_noise_cfg on a zero-variance noise_cfg: 16384 NaN); entail on: no decision (a division inside the guidance helper; no boundary)

rows.title: [Bug]: Qwen3.5 (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration) FLA linear attention tensor format mismatch causes
rows.version: reported nightly 2026-03-31 (open); 0.30.0 first, then the reported version if the symptom is gone
rows.expected_boundary: kernel:vllm.fla (linear attention input layout [B, T, H] vs [B, H, T])
rows.note: the report's checkpoint is an unnamed local NVFP4 export; the most-downloaded public NVFP4 export of the same model (AxionML/Qwen3.5-4B-NVFP4) was used. Not reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 (coherent answers: Paris, 4); reproduced on 0.19.0 (venv vllm0190, the release nearest the reported nightly of 2026-03-31): multilingual token soup on both prompts, as reported. entail on (0.19.0): unknown at the config's unread keys and at the repack step (ModelOptNvFp4LinearMethod has no signature; conv1d not a matrix) - nothing at the linear-attention kernel's input layout, the expected site

rows.title: [Bug]: Triton attention softcap returns NaN for large attention logits
rows.version: 0.30.0 if the helper still has the naive form; else cannot_install_version (main commit c191787a68)
rows.expected_boundary: kernel:vllm.triton_attention apply_softcap (numeric overflow of the softcap helper)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 (the report's Triton probe: apply_softcap gives [50, 50, nan, nan, nan, inf] where tanh gives finite values); entail on: no decision at any boundary (a numeric overflow inside a kernel helper; no launch through JITFunction.run with a strided tensor, no declaration involved)

rows.title: [Bug] Prefill input logprobs are served from the wrong request when a batch member is retracted or f
rows.expected_boundary: request:sglang.logprobs (input-logprob offset per batch member)
rows.note: reproduced on SGLang 0.5.20 (the fix PR's own CPU drive of process_batch_result_prefill: the active request gets [None, -1.0, -2.0], the retracted request's block, instead of [None, -30.0, -31.0]); entail on: no decision (no boundary at the scheduler's result processing)

rows.title: [Bug]: Triton MoE and block-FP8 GEMMs mishandle the K tile — an out-of-bounds weight read, and wrong
rows.expected_boundary: kernel:vllm.w8a8_block_fp8 (K tile vs quantization group; the KernelConfig tile rule's class) and kernel:vllm.fused_moe_gptq_awq (K mask)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 (w8a8_triton_block_scaled_mm with a tuned BLOCK_SIZE_K of 256 over a 128 group: max relative error 0.75; 64 and 128: 1e-4); entail on: the Triton launch boundary decided pass (strides are passed); the K-tile-vs-quantization-group relation (the KernelConfig tile rule of M15, adapters on SGLang only) is not checked on vLLM

rows.title: [Bug]: DeepSeek V4/V32 parser can unwrap arguments using the wrong tool's schema when parallel tool
rows.expected_boundary: request:vllm.tool_parser deepseek_v4 (tool slot name vs schema)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 (the report's drive: tool_b's arguments come back unwrapped as {"city": "Tokyo"} like tool_a's, though tool_b's schema has no city); entail on: no decision (no site at the DSML tool-call parser)

rows.title: Regression in Kimi-K2.5 tokenizer from 5.3.0 to 5.4.0: incorrect codec handling and misleading fix_m
rows.version: reported 5.4.0 (fixed 2026-04-13)
rows.expected_boundary: load:transformers.tokenizer (Vocab / special-token handling across the codec change)
rows.note: not reproduced on 5.17.0 (TikTokenTokenizer decodes 163607 to </think>); reproduced on the reported 5.4.0 (venv tf540: TokenizersBackend decodes 163607 to '' and encodes </think> to 163604); entail on (5.4.0): unknown at load:transformers.tokenizer - 'the engine's tokenizer holds 163584 base tokens and the model's vocabulary is 163840: not the model's tokenizer, and nothing here says whose it is' (the folder has no tokenizer file entail reads: tiktoken), plus the config's unread keys

rows.title: [Bug]: User-authored <|image_pad|> in text is misrecognized as image placeholder, causing image bind
rows.expected_boundary: request:vllm.multimodal placeholders (template-generated placeholder provenance vs token-value matching)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 at the token level, exactly as reported (control: the 256-token image span at 15 after <|vision_start|>, the raw pad at 278; attack: the span at 20 inside the user text, not preceded by <|vision_start|>, the raw pad at 308); the answer did not flip here (YES in both orders with the drawn knife); entail on: only the config's unread keys (unknown) - no boundary at the multimodal placeholder binding

rows.title: DeepSeek-Coder v1 tokenizer produces incorrect output on transformers v5+ (gap in PR #44801's fix)
rows.version: 5.17.0 if the symptom is still there, else reported 5.10.2

rows.note: not reproduced on transformers 5.17.0 (TokenizersBackend, ids equal to tokenizer.json); reproduced on the reported 5.10.2 (venv tf5102: LlamaTokenizer, 4 of 4 strings differ from tokenizer.json); entail on (5.10.2): pass at the tokenizer boundary, no broken - the Vocab check compares sizes, not the ids the class produces

rows.title: [Bug]: FlexAttention paged K/V offsets overflow int32 once `num_gpu_blocks ≥ 2**31 / (block_size · 2
rows.version: 0.30.0 for the vLLM exposure check; the standalone trigger is torch-level and version-independent

rows.note: reproduced with the report's standalone trigger on torch 2.13 (block 65535 gives 0.75, block 65536 with 5 GiB mapped below gives -8.0: silent wrong attention); entail on: no decision - the compiled FlexAttention kernel is launched by Inductor, not through JITFunction.run
